sourceRefs.locator: Curator’s object description, the numeral and reed for 1487, the two rulers Tízoc and Ahuítzotl making blood offerings, the bundle between them and the probable ceremonial-square display.
Archaeological zone, Guatemala 60, Centro Histórico, and Datos generales, site of the principal building of ancient Tenochtitlan.
Overview; Key Events, ca. 1427 and ca. 1431. Tenochtitlan’s alliance with Texcoco and Tlacopan, Azcapotzalco, indirect rule, tribute and Tlaxcala’s autonomy. Earlier enlargements of the main temple.

labels.en: Eight Reed at the Great Temple

note.de: Am Ausbau des Großen Tempels erinnert die Gedenktafel an Tízoc und Ahuítzotl. Das Jahr Acht Rohr entspricht hier 1487. Die Karte zeigt den Zeremonialbezirk.
note.en: A commemorative plaque associates Tízoc and Ahuítzotl with the enlargement of the Great Temple. Eight Reed corresponds here to 1487. The point marks the ceremonial precinct.
